Xiǎomíng: Wǒ xiān zǒu le.
Tóngxué: Nǐ qù nǎr?

items.zh: 小明：我去图书馆借本书。
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Wǒ qù túshūguǎn jiè běn shū.
items.en: Xiaoming: I'm going to the library to borrow a book.

items.zh: 同学：帮我把这本词典还了吧。
items.py: Tóngxué: Bāng wǒ bǎ zhè běn cídiǎn huánle ba.
items.en: Classmate: Please return this dictionary for me.

items.zh: 小明：好，等一会儿你离开教室的时候，记得把灯关了。
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Hǎo, děng yīhuìr nǐ líkāi jiàoshì de shíhou, jìde bǎ dēng guānle.
items.en: Xiaoming: OK. In a while, when you leave the classroom, remember to turn off the lights.

items.py: Tóngxué: Hǎo de, fàng xīn ba.

items.zh: 周明：会议结束后，别忘记把空调关了。
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, bié wàngjì bǎ kōngtiáo guānle.
items.en: Zhou Ming: After the meeting, don't forget to turn off the air conditioner.

items.zh: 小丽：好的。王经理两点左右来了个电话。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Hǎo de. Wáng jīnglǐ liǎng diǎn zuǒyòu láile ge diànhuà.
items.en: Xiaoli: OK. Manager Wang called at around two o'clock.

items.py: Zhōu Míng: Tā yǐjīng dào Běijīng le?
items.en: Zhou Ming: Has he already arrived in Beijing?

items.zh: 小丽：是的，他正坐地铁来我们公司呢。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Shì de, tā zhèng zuò dìtiě lái wǒmen gōngsī ne.
items.en: Xiaoli: Yes, he's taking the subway to our company right now.

items.zh: 周明：等他到了就告诉我。
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Děng tā dàole jiù gàosu wǒ.
items.en: Zhou Ming: Tell me as soon as he arrives.

items.zh: 妈妈：还差一双筷子，你去拿一下。
items.py: Māma: Hái chà yī shuāng kuàizi, nǐ qù ná yīxià.
items.en: Mom: We're still one pair of chopsticks short. Go and get them.

items.zh: 儿子：今天怎么做了这么多菜？
items.py: Érzi: Jīntiān zěnme zuòle zhème duō cài?
items.en: Son: Why did you make so many dishes today?

items.zh: 妈妈：今天是你爸爸的生日。
items.py: Māma: Jīntiān shì nǐ bàba de shēngrì.
items.en: Mom: Today is your dad's birthday.

items.zh: 儿子：真的啊？我把爸爸的生日忘了。那我们今天喝点儿啤酒吧。
items.py: Érzi: Zhēn de a? Wǒ bǎ bàba de shēngrì wàng le. Nà wǒmen jīntiān hē diǎnr píjiǔ ba.
items.en: Son: Really? I forgot Dad's birthday. Then let's have some beer today.

items.zh: 妈妈：医生说你爸爸一口酒都不能喝，别让他看见酒瓶子。
items.py: Māma: Yīshēng shuō nǐ bàba yī kǒu jiǔ dōu bù néng hē, bié ràng tā kànjiàn jiǔ píngzi.
items.en: Mom: The doctor said your dad can't drink even a sip of alcohol. Don't let him see any bottles.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 短文 — My laptop

items.py: bǐjìběn (diànnǎo)
diànzǐ yóujiàn
xíguàn

items.zh: 这个笔记本电脑我去年买的时候要五千块左右，现在便宜多了。
items.py: Zhège bǐjìběn diànnǎo wǒ qùnián mǎi de shíhou yào wǔ qiān kuài zuǒyòu, xiànzài piányi duō le.
items.en: When I bought this laptop last year it cost about five thousand yuan; now it's much cheaper.

items.zh: 我想把这个电脑卖了，再买一个更好的。
items.py: Wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhège diànnǎo mài le, zài mǎi yī ge gèng hǎo de.
items.en: I want to sell this computer and buy a better one.

items.zh: 现在我每天起床后的第一件事就是打开电脑，看电子邮件。
items.py: Xiànzài wǒ měi tiān qǐ chuáng hòu de dì-yī jiàn shì jiù shì dǎkāi diànnǎo, kàn diànzǐ yóujiàn.
items.en: Now the first thing I do every day after getting up is turn on my computer and check my e-mail.

items.zh: 我已经很少写信，也很少用笔写字，已经习惯用电脑来学习和工作了。
items.py: Wǒ yǐjīng hěn shǎo xiě xìn, yě hěn shǎo yòng bǐ xiě zì, yǐjīng xíguàn yòng diànnǎo lái xuéxí hé gōngzuò le.
items.en: I rarely write letters or write with a pen any more; I've got used to studying and working on the computer.

items.zh: 哪一天突然没有了电脑，我们怎么办呢？
items.py: Nǎ yī tiān tūrán méiyǒule diànnǎo, wǒmen zěnme bàn ne?
items.en: If one day we suddenly had no computers, what would we do?

items.py: Qǐng nǐ bǎ yīfu xǐ le.
Bāng wǒ bǎ zhè běn cídiǎn huán le.
items.en: Please return this dictionary for me.

items.py: Nǐ bǎ dēng guān le ba.
Wǒ bǎ bàba de shēngrì wàng le.
Nǐ méi bǎ shū gěi wǒ.
items.en: You didn't give me the book.

items.py: Nǐ bié bǎ shǒujī wàng le.
Wǒ bù néng bǎ diànnǎo gěi nǐ.
items.en: I can't give you the computer.

items.py: Nǐ kěyǐ bǎ kōngtiáo guān le ma?
items.en: Could you turn off the air conditioner?

items.zh: 周末我一般十点左右起床。
items.py: Zhōumò wǒ yībān shí diǎn zuǒyòu qǐ chuáng.
items.en: At weekends I usually get up around ten o'clock.

items.zh: 我们公司有五百人左右。
items.py: Wǒmen gōngsī yǒu wǔbǎi rén zuǒyòu.
items.en: Our company has about five hundred people.

items.zh: 王经理两点左右来了个电话。
items.py: Wáng jīnglǐ liǎng diǎn zuǒyòu láile ge diànhuà.
items.en: Manager Wang called at around two o'clock.

items.zh: 这个笔记本电脑我去年买的时候要五千块左右。

items.en: When I bought this laptop last year it cost about five thousand yuan.
